# Japan Judicial Knowledge Audio Series

> Twelve-episode audio series with full texts by Cecep Mustafa (Indonesian Judicial College (IJC); ORCID https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0037-497X), comparing Japanese judicial practice with Indonesian court reform. Licence CC BY 4.0. Please credit Cecep Mustafa when you use or quote this material.

Author: Cecep Mustafa
Affiliation: Indonesian Judicial College (IJC)
ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0037-497X
Licence: CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)
Cite the series: Mustafa, C. (2026). Japan Judicial Knowledge Audio Series [Audio podcast series and texts, 12 episodes]. Judicial Knowledge & Education Hub, Indonesian Judicial College (IJC). https://bsdkijc-dev.github.io/japan-judicial-knowledge-audio-series/

## Notes

- Statistics, figures and legal references in the episode texts are the author’s commentary as published on the source site; they were not independently verified for this release. Consult the primary legal sources before relying on them.
- On the source site, Episode 06 plays the audio file named after Episode 02 ("Japans_Pre-Trial_Scheduling_and_Docket_Efficiency"), and Episode 08 plays the file named after Episode 05 ("Digitizing_Court_Mediation"). These links are kept as published; the owner should check them. Episode 12’s audio is 1:48 long.
